$comment: Each entry records a workflow that ALREADY violates one or more policy rules
at the accepted repository state. An entry means KNOWN EXISTING DEBT — it does
NOT mean the workflow is an approved-safe design. It exists only so the guard
does not block the current accepted repository while still failing on any NEW
sha256 is over the workflow file's canonical (LF-normalised) bytes. If a listed
workflow changes by one byte its digest changes, the exception stops applying,
and workflow-policy.mjs --strict FAILS — forcing CENTRAL review. Likewise a
violation id that appears on a listed workflow but is NOT in its `violations`
array is treated as a new violation and FAILS.
Only CENTRAL may edit this file, and only after reviewing the workflow change
that motivates it. Recommended remediation for the current debt is tracked in

ruleTitles.WF-012: automatically executable provider-sensitive workflow with no explicit human-dispatch guard
